_README: A filled, working example (Jetson AGX Thor-class, values from the public product page). Copy the template for other devices. Machine-specific configs you add should be named <name>.local.json (gitignored).
module: p3834-0008 (Jetson AGX Thor T5000, carrier p4071-0000)
vram_note: unified memory - capacity auto-detected from MemTotal at run time

datasheet.notes: dense (non-sparse) figures; 2070 FP4-sparse TFLOPS headline / 8 = 259 fp16 dense;; dense (non-sparse) figures

vdd_gpu.label: VDD_GPU
vdd_gpu.note: watts = mV * mA / 1e6; resolve hwmon index by name, never hardcode hwmonN

soctherm_oc.note: overcurrent throttle sensor; attribute layout undocumented - sample best-effort, blank field if unreadable

quirks: nvidia-smi on Tegra reports no per-process memory, no VBIOS/serial, no power cap
an empty compute-apps list is NOT evidence of idleness - corroborate with the INA238 idle-power baseline
trtexec lives only at /usr/src/tensorrt/bin - not on default PATH
jetson_clocks --show needs root; /sys/class/devfreq/* is readable unprivileged and is the authoritative lock check (min==max==cur)
/sys/devices/gpu.0/** does not exist on tegra264 - Xavier/Orin layout, do not probe
overcurrent clamps are ms-scale: throughput dips 15-30% while sampled clocks read max - they are data, not lock failure
sampler_period_note: 73.1 ms, not a multiple of the 33.3 ms frame: the ina238 module-power register is instantaneous (no averaging) and a 100 ms poll phase-locks to a 30 Hz row (2026-08-28 finding); VDD_GPU on the ina3221 is hardware-averaged (512 samples) and unaffected
